subject: Deploying an app with extra files (.js)

messages.author: a70102b7393f797f
messages.subject: Deploying an app with extra files (.js)
parts:
Hello,

I´m developing an app that has one tab with a map powered by Leaflet. The map works fine locally, but it does not appear in ShinyApps. I realized that the problem is that the app does not find the js files. I'm new to ShinyApps and thought that was enough having the files in the folder that was being deployed, then everything would be loaded. 

How can I make the js files readable to shinyApps?

The whole code is too long, the parts involved are:

server.R
json <- readLines("br-states.js")

ui.R
includeHTML("mapa.js")

If someone want to see my app draft: https://psuantt.shinyapps.io/Consolidado/    (the map is the last tab)

Thanks in advance!!

Luis Otavio

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploying an app with extra files (.js)
parts:
Luis,

I think you need to create a subdirectory called "www" and put your javascript file in there. You can then use the includeScript function inside your UI.R. For example:

includeScript('www/mapa.js')

Thanks
-Andy

messages.author: 07082c2b48d8d18a
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploying an app with extra files (.js)
parts:
Luis,

If you calls a script with includeScript, it should work. If not, then we have a bug in Shiny or ShinyApps. So let's make sure it works. Can you check

1. That you .js files contain just raw javascript. No HTML, no extra quotes, etc.
2. That you get your script back surrounded by <script></script> tags if you run includeScripts(<filepath>) at the command line.

Also, Joe Cheng has made a package that binds leaflet to Shiny (https://github.com/jcheng5/leaflet-shiny). I don't know the details of your app, but if you aren't using it, Joe's package might save you some time and headaches.

Good luck!
Garrett

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deploying an app with extra files (.js)
parts:
When I opened your app, I saw these error messages in the JavaScript console:

[blocked] The page at 'https://psuantt.shinyapps.io/Consolidado/'
was loaded over HTTPS, but ran insecure content from
'http://cdn.leafletjs.com/leaflet-0.5.1/leaflet.css': this content
should also be loaded over HTTPS.
[blocked] The page at 'https://psuantt.shinyapps.io/Consolidado/'
was loaded over HTTPS, but ran insecure content from
'http://cdn.leafletjs.com/leaflet-0.5.1/leaflet.js': this content
should also be loaded over HTTPS.

This means you should replace the http link with https, but
unfortunately the official website of leaflet.js does not provide the
https links. After a quick google search, I found this:
http://cdnjs.com/libraries/leaflet If you do not trust third-party
hosts, you can just download leaflet and put it in your app.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>

I would like to thank the four of you for the great help. 

in mapa.js instead of: 

<link rel = "stylesheet" href = "http://cdn.leafletjs.com/leaflet-0.5.1/leaflet.css" /> 
<- [if lte IE 8]> 
     <link rel = "stylesheet" href = "http://cdn.leafletjs.com/leaflet-0.5.1/leaflet.ie.css" /> 
<! [endif] -> 

I put: 
<link rel = "stylesheet" href = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/0.7.3/leaflet.css" /> 
<script src = "https: ////cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/0.7.3/leaflet.js"> </ script> 

Yihui's link from - http://cdnjs.com/libraries/leaflet 

Now is working! => https://psuantt.shinyapps.io/Tab2/

Thanks and Regards, 

Luis
